description: As insert-implicit, but the INSERT writes 4096 rows (INSERT INTO T (ID, K, V) SELECT a.n * 256 + b.n * 16 + c.n, CStr(c.n) & '-' & CStr(b.n) & '-' & CStr(a.n), a.n FROM S AS a, S AS b, S AS c) and T also has a MEMO column filled by UPDATE T SET M = String(1000, 'm') in the same program, as a second implicit statement. Participant b takes 20 samples 25 ms apart, each a suspension of a with per-page (4096-byte) hashes of the database, then resumes it; one more after a's statements returned, and a takes one after Close. Asks which pages change in which sample, and in which order data pages, index pages and the file's growth appear.
retentionNote: Designed r-sample-rec probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
